verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents a parse capability that uploads local files, including PDF, DOCX, and XLSX, directly to its /v2/parse endpoint. It turns them into Markdown or structured JSON, so the user does not need to host the files. PowerPoint is not explicitly named, only implied by "and more" and "etc." missing for 10: explicit PowerPoint/PPTX support, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality across these formats.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract text content from PDFs, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without hosting them myself

citations.quote: Turn local PDFs, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, and more into Markdown or structured JSON
Use `parse` to upload local files (`html`, `pdf`, `docx`, `xlsx`, etc.) directly to `/v2/parse`.
